wall_time_components.note: Dispatch-to-delivered-response includes message delivery delay. Native completed-turn duration is separately exported in policy_usage. Simulated control time is separate; residual is not model latency.
wall_time_components.clock_scope: Episode setup/execution/elapsed fields use time.monotonic(); not UTC timestamp subtraction. Long quota/operator interruption and any host-clock suspend behavior prevent end-to-end speed interpretation.

policy_usage.policy_time_note: Sum of native task_complete.duration_ms; excludes operator waits between turns and subsequent delivery of the result to Sol. Dispatch-to-delivered-response is a separate clock.
